When nothing parses, *out = default and the error code is 0x21 (0x143a42f88). A null map pointer at self+8 writes the default with error code 2 (0x143a42f3c). A key that is not in the map writes the default and returns 2 with no tag and no ring entry (0x143a43187). Callers Game_Podium2019CutSceneScript_ChooseCutScenesToPlay, Asset_Load_DevSessionWorlds.
